create_apertus_config: create an ApertusConfig instance with default model parameters for the Apertus-8B architecture
init_apertus_model: initialize an ApertusModel from an ApertusConfig configuration object
access_model_config: access the configuration object from an instantiated ApertusModel via model.config
configure_rope_parameters: configure Llama3-style RoPE parameters with theta, factor, and position scaling settings
inspect_config_attributes: inspect ApertusConfig attributes such as vocab_size, hidden_size, num_hidden_layers, and attention heads
